faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Training) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India with more than 2 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.10.2026.

faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.answer: The consolidated payout is in the range of Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month.
